headline: Important News for Those Planning to Buy Their First Home: From Today, the Down Payment Requirement Is Decreasing
summary: Updated Responsible Lending Rules from the Bank of Lithuania give first-time home buyers more favourable conditions. The down payment requirement decreases from today.
why: The Bank of Lithuania is the national central bank and sets lending rules that determine how much borrowers must put down on a mortgage.
